sections.A: Bachchon mein hip aur ghutne ke ahem masle umar ke mutabiq: DDH (paidaish), transient synovitis aur septic arthritis, Perthes (4-8 saal), SCFE (10-16 saal) aur Osgood-Schlatter.
sections.B: Langrata bachcha hip ke masle ki sab se ahem nishani hai. SCFE aur Perthes aksar ghutne ke dard ke saath aate hain.
sections.C: Umar, achanak ya dheere dheere shuruaat, chot, bukhar, wazan uthana aur raat ka dard.
sections.D: Barlow aur Ortolani (newborn), Galeazzi sign, hip rotation aur doosre tests umar ke mutabiq.
sections.F: Langrate bachche mein septic arthritis (bukhar, bohat bimar), transient synovitis, Perthes aur SCFE ka farq table mein hai.
sections.G: Bukhar, bimar lagna, wazan na uthana aur hip hilane par shadeed dard (septic arthritis): emergency. Naujawan mein hip rotation kam (SCFE): urgent.
sections.H: Langrata bachcha: bukhar ya wazan na uthana ho to emergency. Naujawan mein internal rotation kam ho to SCFE ka shak, urgent refer.
sections.I: DDH, Perthes aur SCFE orthopaedics sambhalte hain; physio range, taaqat aur chalne mein madad karti hai. Osgood-Schlatter mein load control aur exercise.
sections.N: Sawaal hal karein. Ghutne ke dard wale bachche mein hip zaroor check karein.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
